title: Airbnb Layover: Fill the Time with the Fewest Experiences
prompt:
You have an `X`-hour layover in Paris and a list of experiences, each with a duration given to one decimal place. You may repeat an experience any number of times. Fill the layover exactly with as few experiences as possible; if no combination totals exactly `X`, book nothing.

Implement `min_exact_items(durations, target) -> int`, returning that minimum count or `0` when an exact fill is impossible. For this coding exercise, assume all durations are positive, the target is nonnegative, and both have at most one decimal place. Treat tenths exactly rather than relying on binary floating-point equality. A zero target returns `0`.

example.reasoning: One 3.0-hour experience and two 2.0-hour experiences fill the seven-hour layover with three selections.

references.label: 1Point3Acres: Airbnb MLE onsite exact-fill report (decimal durations, repeat allowed)
